reason: My admin already types the receipts into Excel every week. Yes, she's always behind, but it gets done, and half of what I spend is cash to mechanics with no receipt anyway, so a bot reading Telegram photos only covers part of it. I might let the guys throw the free 30 at it to see what happens, but I'm not paying $19 a month on top of a salary I already pay for this job.
objection: It's paying twice for the same job. My admin still has to chase the cash stuff and fix whatever the bot gets wrong, and I'm not sure I want some bot sitting in my work group and my Google account.
would_change_my_mind: If the free 30 caught a real duplicate or a padded parts receipt that my admin missed, money I can actually see I'd lost, I'd pay the $19 without thinking about it.
